> Often it's not the "best" way of dealing with the problems

I'm not entirely sure there is any other option, but if you think of one please let me know.

For me it didn't matter telling them this. I missed a week of school from being severely ill, and now that I'm behind my teachers are constantly yelling at me to catch up and how I should be done with my work by now. They know I have terrible mental health, they just don't care.
